screens.name: Birthday editor — populated

screens.name: Birth details — initial time entry

limitations: All scores are provisional browser assessments based on the supplied screenshots and runtime narrative; no tools, source, prior grades or independent runtime checks were used.
For each item, A is the mean of its applicable hierarchy, typography and surfaces scores; F is the mean of its applicable clarity, feedback and accessibility scores; overall is round(0.4A + 0.6F, 1).
The A>=9 and F>=9 threshold is not met across all screens and components; stronger items do not cancel weaker states.
Related settled states and their transition captures are grouped; still frames support visual correspondence but cannot establish perceived motion quality.

The text-free contrast captures in sheets 23–27 are treated as diagnostic imagery rather than settled product screens; their capture method is not established here, so they cannot prove either missing product text or accessible product text.

Content outside a screenshot’s viewport is not classified as unreachable solely because it is offscreen; supplied overflow and routing checks support browser reachability but do not establish effortless discovery.
Circles is graded as an honest offline recovery screen; successful circle creation, authentication and populated social behavior remain unestablished.
Synthetic answers, source passages, layout errors and named test-provider content establish presentation boundaries, not production copy quality or prediction accuracy.
Physical iPhone, VoiceOver, native Dynamic Type, keyboard, speech, haptics, payments and OS sharing remain unverified; browser scores of 9 do not certify those boundaries.
No novice study or representative physical-device usability evidence supports a score of 10.
No confirmed browser hard-gate failure is established by the supplied settled-state evidence; this does not certify untested functionality.
topFixes: Promote the available action in city lookup and offline Circles instead of emphasizing disabled buttons.
Clarify whether check-in reminders are scheduled or merely suggested dates.
Explain why an unavailable omen uses the daily attempt and replace technical storage wording.
Keep a concise consent scope visible beside the final Allow/Not now decision.
Improve compact share-preview legibility and reduce unnecessary vertical space in enlarged forms.
Standardize evidence navigation and confidence wording, then validate automatic answer advancement with representative users.
